messages:
sam: Quick sync: we've got multiple fallback types firing simultaneously during canary traffic spikes (region failover + capacity fallback). need a deterministic arbitration algorithm.
anya: agreed. current naive priority list is brittle. suggest we define a numeric priority_score and a secondary "impact_est" (latency_ms / cost_pct) so the engine can pick lowest user-impact option when severity ties.
ji-hoon: +1. also want a hard ordering constraint: safety guards (quota, auth) must run before any state-changing fallback.
tara: UX: console should show for each fallback a 2-line preview: what changes (route/model/queue), expected p95 delta, and whether it's destructive. users should be able to set allow_destructive: true/false per rollout.
sam: prototype config (still rough):
```
rollout_id: canary-2026-03-21
splits:
  - variant: model-v2
    weight: 0.12
fallbacks:
  - id: regional-ff
    trigger: region_unhealthy(us-east-1)
    priority_score: 90
    impact_est: latency_ms=120,cost_pct=10
    action: route_to(us-west-2)
    destructive: false
  - id: capacity-shed
    trigger: gpu_util>0.92
    priority_score: 85
    impact_est: latency_ms=40,cost_pct=-25
    action: replace_model(model-v2-quant8)
    destructive: true
  - id: degrade-batching
    trigger: p95_latency>1200
    priority_score: 70
    impact_est: latency_ms=80,cost_pct=-15
    action: reduce_batch_size(32->8)
    destructive: false
```
anya: engine tie-breaker proposal: 1) validate guards pass (quota/auth) 2) collect all active fallback candidates 3) prefer candidates with higher priority_score 4) among equal score, pick candidate with lower impact_est.latency_ms 5) if still equal, prefer non-destructive 6) deterministic final tie-breaker: fallback id lexicographic.
matt: telemetry: emit rollout.fallback.elected with labels: rollout_id, fallback_id, trigger, chosen_action, priority_score, impact_est, decision_path. also emit rollout.fallback.attempted for candidates that lost arbitration.
observability-bot: [info] new metric: rollout.fallbacks.elected_total (counter) and rollout.fallback.impact_ms (histogram). adding tags rollout_id, fallback_id.
ji-hoon: careful about loops: fallback action must not re-trigger the same fallback immediately. need a cooldown per rollout + per fallback. recommend 5m default cooldown, configurable.
tara: on A/B tests: if a fallback changes model semantics (destructive=true), mark experiment as interrupted and annotate experiment analytics. we must keep experiment integrity for statistical tests.
sam: compliance: add audit event when auto_destructive is enabled and when it fires (user, timestamp, rollout_id, fallback_id). enterprise customers can set auto_destructive=false by policy.
matt: I'll add the audit event hook and the metric wiring.
ji-hoon: I'll implement the arbitration logic and cooldown. I'll also make the engine simulate impact_estimates using recent traces.
anya: API docs: show validation rules (priority_score numeric 0-100, impact_est fields, destructive boolean). SDK should reject rollouts with destructive=true unless user explicitly sets allow_destructive on the rollout.
sam: thanks. next steps: PR for API + engine changes, UI mock from tara, metrics + audit from matt, SRE review for region ordering. tagging @eng-sre for the ordering confirmation.
deploy-bot: sam created workflow autofallback_arbitration (id: afr-901). CI checks queued.
sam: will follow up on PR comments.
